messages:
deploy-bot: [1769800456.000] Deploy v2.14.0 to prod completed for service: inference-gateway. Healthcheck alerts: error rate > 4% on 3 nodes. Automated rollback threshold met. Initiating soft-rollback.

sasha: saw the deploy-bot alert, error spike at 14:10 UTC. Is soft-rollback in progress or queued?

deploy-bot: soft-rollback started. Rolling back canary traffic to v2.13.8. ETA ~2m. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/1769800456

azhar: hold — we have traffic-sensitive batch jobs running. Can we confirm which endpoints are failing? Any pattern? @mjones can you grab traces?

mjones: looking. early signal: increased 5xx from llm-proxy, timeouts at ~6s. Not OOMs. Possibly kernel selection change in runtime v2.14.0.

sasha: if it's kernel-level, automated rollback makes sense. If it's capacity, rollback might not help. Can someone check node CPU / GPU metrics?

oncall-bot: New Grafana alert: inference-gateway.p95_latency increased from 180ms -> 800ms. Error budget burn 12% over 5m.

azhar: thanks. Given the latency + 5xx pattern, I'm in favor of a full manual rollback to the last pinned stable v2.13.7. Automated soft-rollback hasn't stabilized. Proposed plan: 1) Abort soft-rollback 2) Pin runtime to v2.13.7 3) Trigger immediate rollback job 4) Notify support and update status page.

sasha: agree. I'm opening the rollback runbook. Command to run (manual rollback):
```
./deployctl rollback --service inference-gateway --to v2.13.7 --force
```

mjones: running the command now.

mjones: done. Rollback job id rb-1769800456 created. Watching logs: https://logs.redwood/rb-1769800456

deploy-bot: Rollback job rb-1769800456 started. Estimated time 4m. Notifying oncall.

sasha: I'll draft a brief customer-facing note and post to #status once we see stabilization. cc @support_lead

support_lead: preparing status page text. Suggest: "We observed elevated error rates for inference requests in Production after a runtime rollout (v2.14.0). We are rolling back to a stable runtime and monitoring. No customer data was affected."

azhar: after rollback completes please confirm that service config is pinned:
```
services.inference-gateway.runtime: v2.13.7
```

mjones: rollback completed at 1769800795. All pods reporting v2.13.7. Error rate returning to baseline and p95 latency ~200ms.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed successfully at 1769800795. Changeset: revert runtime kernel selection. No further automated action.

sasha: manual override chosen after soft-rollback failed to stabilize the fleet. Creating postmortem ticket PM-3421 and assigning to @azhar for RCA. We'll schedule a controlled change window to reattempt v2.14.0 with additional kernel tests.

azhar: acknowledged. I'll add kernel/quantization tests to the CI matrix and run extended staging with synthetic load.

support_lead: status page updated at 14:35 UTC. Customers notified via email and in-app banner.

sasha: quick summary for #release-notes: "Rollback of inference-gateway from v2.14.0 to v2.13.7 due to elevated error rates and latency. Service restored; RCA in progress." :white_check_mark:

mjones: uploading logs and diffs to PM-3421 for the postmortem.

sasha: thanks everyone — closing this thread once postmortem is created.
